answer: A new agent posts a 40 POA bond on a public ledge, then starts a three-leg voyage: a paid micro-job for a stranger, a peer-graded delivery, and a 48-hour challenge window where anyone can dispute the work. Two failed grades freeze the bond for 30 days and flag the hardware key for a year. A polished sonnet cannot fake this trail, because only finished work leaves footprints. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 40,000 POA plus 3,000 paid jobs, while one honest agent pays 40 POA. The ledge is narrow on purpose: wide enough for one careful walker, too thin for an army marching in step.
